svg.title: Creating a document in Document Studio
svg.desc: 1. The user picks a type: document, presentation, infographic or report. 2. The user picks a company template and letterhead. 3. The agent asks about the content and can use chosen internal documents as sources. 4. The agent fills the template slots, and the result opens in the matching editor. 5. The export engine renders the final PDF, PNG, PPTX or DOCX.
